title: Arrows, lines and measurements catch pinned guides too
goal: You can pin a guide onto the picture and a dragged or resized box catches it. The end of an arrow, a line or a measurement does not: those go down a different path and slide straight past the guide. Make every end that snaps to a grid line snap to a guide as well, so a guide means the same thing wherever you are drawing.
notes: Guides landed on 2026-09-06 (audit queue/audits/2026-09-06-grid-guides.json). Snapping.snapFrameOrigin and snapResizedFrame both take a guides: [CanvasGuide] parameter and turn each guide into a full span candidate; AnnotationSnapping.snap is the other path and has no guides parameter yet. CanvasView.snappedAnnotationPoint and snappedTextOrigin are the two call sites, and both already pass gridSpacing/gridOrigin/gridAxes, so the shape of the change is the same one Snapping.swift already has. Text placement deliberately takes no guide today: a click has no opposite end and nothing is being dragged, which is the same reason it takes no edge magnet, so decide whether a guide is different before adding one there.
acceptance: Dragging the end of an arrow or a line onto a pinned guide catches it, and the same yellow line lights that a dragged layer gets
Placing or moving the foot of a measurement catches a pinned guide the same way
Holding Command frees an end from a guide exactly as it frees it from the grid
Core tests cover an annotation end catching a guide on each axis, written before the change
